title: 19 rescued after motorbanca sinks off Punta Engaño, Lapu-Lapu City

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines- Nineteen individuals were rescued after the motorbanca they were aboard experienced engine trouble while navigating the waters between Olango Island and Punta Engaño in mainland Lapu-Lapu City early Tuesday morning, November 3. According to reports, the group, composed of relatives, had come from Getafe, Bohol, where they spent the Kalag-Kalag break. They were on their way to Angasil Port in Lapu-Lapu City when the motorbanca encountered engine trouble. The group, which included three minors and a senior citizen, was headed to their respective residences in Barangay Pasil, Cebu City, and Mandaue City.
